description: Allegheny County 911 Dispatches - EMS and Fire is a dataset listed in Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center (WPRDC), an open data portal, published or maintained by Allegheny County. The Allegheny County 911 center answers and dispatches 911 calls for 111 out of 130 municipalities in Allegheny County. Agencies are dispatched via a computer aided dispatch (CAD) system. This dataset contains dispatched EMS and Fire events from the CAD and includes details about the nature of the emergency. Coverage: Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. The portal files it under the publisher Allegheny County. Its tags are 9-1-1, 911, _etl, cad, dispatch. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-wprdc-portal.
